calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores,
           COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year

WITH mine AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
),
m AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(v) AS mine FROM mine GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales AS ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
      WHERE store_id < 900 AND (business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')),
j AS (SELECT COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date) AS d, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, COALESCE(mine,0) AS mine, COALESCE(ctrl,0) AS ctrl
      FROM m FULL JOIN c ON m.business_date=c.business_date AND m.store_id=c.store_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN d >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'TY' ELSE 'LY' END AS yr, store_id,
       SUM(mine) AS mine, SUM(ctrl) AS ctrl, SUM(mine)-SUM(ctrl) AS diff, COUNT(*) AS n_days
FROM j GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING ABS(SUM(mine)-SUM(ctrl)) > 1 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH days AS (
  SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.is_trading_day
  FROM dim_date d
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17)
),
st AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
grid AS (SELECT st.*, days.* FROM st CROSS JOIN days),
sales AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales)
SELECT g.fiscal_year, g.store_id, g.store_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trading_days,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.is_trading_day AND COALESCE(s.net_sales,0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_with_sales,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.net_sales,0)) AS net
FROM grid g LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.business_date=g.calendar_date AND s.store_id=g.store_id
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <> SUM(CASE WHEN g.is_trading_day AND COALESCE(s.net_sales,0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY 2,1
